name: Instruction Status Return Criteria 1
definition: Defines the criteria which are used to report on the payment status.

PaymentInstructionStatusIndicator.name: Payment Instruction Status Indicator
PaymentInstructionStatusIndicator.definition: Indicates if the instruction status is requested.

PaymentInstructionStatusDateTimeIndicato.name: Payment Instruction Status Date Time Indicator
PaymentInstructionStatusDateTimeIndicato.definition: Indicates if the status date and time are requested.

PaymentInstructionStatusReasonIndicator.name: Payment Instruction Status Reason Indicator
PaymentInstructionStatusReasonIndicator.definition: Indicates if the status reason is requested.
